entities.name: Çavuşzade Mehmed Cemâleddin Efendi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mehmed Džemaludin ef. Čaušević was a Bosnian cleric, thinker, educator, reformer, journalist, translator and linguist who served as the 4th Grand Mufti for Bosnia and Herzegovina from 1914 to 1930. He was one of the most significant and influential Bosnian Muslim personalities of the 20th century.
